message.content:
The derivative of \(f(x)=2x^{2}\) is  

\[
f'(x)= \frac{d}{dx}(2x^{2}) = 4x .
\]

Evaluating this at \(x=1\):

\[
f'(1)=4(1)=\boxed{4}.
\]
